goal: Make CGKN MCP failures directly machine-identifiable with root-cause, contributing-failure, secondary-effect, and safe-resume diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: The MCP exposes one read-only structured diagnostic tool with a typed output and honest read-only, closed-world annotations.
A blocked generation identifies one primary stage, component, target, category, and bounded summary without treating downstream missing files as the root cause.
Provider transport, local fallback contract rejection, response parsing, and checkpoint identity drift are reported as contributing failures with bounded counts.
Resume is safe only for a goal-matching pending repair plan with stable recorded component spec identity; drift forces a fresh reviewed run recommendation.
The same compact diagnosis is returned by generation and status, while MCP boundary exceptions carry a stable machine-readable failure category.
Diagnostics redact secrets, perform no retry or candidate write, create no generation or delivery path, and remain formal evidence NOT_EVALUATED.
Plugin, skill, kernel, project-management, and real prior-failure replay tests pass.

quality_metrics.target: the prior exam-project fixture classifies the leaf contract as primary and missing files as secondary
quality_metrics.method: MCP integration fixture and live artifact replay

quality_metrics.target: 100% of fixtures with per-component spec-hash drift return resume.safe=false
zero secret values returned and formal status always NOT_EVALUATED
quality_metrics.method: secret-bearing fixture, schema inspection, and kernel guard

quality_metrics.target: all targeted tests and validators pass
quality_metrics.method: pytest, plugin validation, skill validation, and project-management validation

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: cgkn_diagnose_failure returns primary_failure, contributing_failures, secondary_effects, resume, counts, sources, and recommended_next_action.
cgkn_generate and cgkn_status expose the same diagnosis shape without removing their existing full evidence fields.
MCP errors retain isError=true and add failure.category, failure.summary, failure.retryable, and failure.source.

feedback: Structured MCP diagnostics identify the prior exam-project root cause, contributing failures, downstream effects, and unsafe checkpoint resume without changing generation authority.

worked: A shared deterministic diagnostic projection made generate, status, and direct diagnosis agree on one bounded failure contract.
did_not_work: Raw generation results and artifact-presence status previously forced Codex to infer causality from large nested payloads.
experiments: Track whether future blocked runs require any manual log inspection after cgkn_diagnose_failure returns.
